issue.title: Accessibility: scaffolded Identity validation summary produces an invalid ul with role=alert
issue.body:
The Blazor Web App Individual Accounts template scaffolds its Identity pages with ``. `ValidationSummary` renders a `
    `, so the `role="alert"` is applied to the `
      ` element. `alert` is not an allowed ARIA role for `
        `, and applying it overrides the list's implicit `list` role, which in turn strips the list context from the child `
      • ` elements. Automated accessibility tooling reports this as an `aria-allowed-role` violation on the `
          ` and a `listitem` violation on each `
        • `. ## Environment - Product build: `dotnet-unified-build` (VMR), branch `main`, build `20260630.1`, source commit `0fd8828d93f200b303d9403be5af0f902f858ba7`. - SDK `11.0.100-preview.7.26330.101`, ASP.NET Core `11.0.0-preview.7.26330.101`. - The same template markup is also present on `release/10.0`. ## Affected The scaffolded Identity Account pages that render a validation summary, in the Blazor Web App Individual Accounts template: Login, Register, ForgotPassword, ResendEmailConfirmation, and the Manage pages (ChangePassword, Email, Index, and so on). ## Steps to reproduce 1. Create a Blazor Web App with Individual Accounts authentication. 2. Navigate to a page with a validation summary, for example Login, and submit the form with empty required fields so the summary renders. 3. Inspect the rendered validation summary in the DOM, or run an automated accessibility check (axe-core) against the page. ## Expected The list of validation errors is a valid list: the `
            ` keeps its `list` role and the `
          • ` items are valid list items. ## Actual The rendered markup is: ```html
            • The Email field is required.
            • The Password field is required.
            ``` `role="alert"` is not allowed on `
              ` (axe `aria-allowed-role`), and because it replaces the implicit `list` role the `
            • ` children are no longer in a valid list context (axe `listitem`). ## Root cause and source The role comes from the template markup, not from the `ValidationSummary` component (the component correctly forwards additional attributes onto the `
                ` it renders). The template applies it here: - File: `src/ProjectTemplates/Web.ProjectTemplates/content/BlazorWeb-CSharp/BlazorWebCSharp.1/Components/Account/Pages/Login.razor` and the sibling `Account/Pages/*.razor` files. - Snippet: `` - Source: https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/blob/main/src/ProjectTemplates/Web.ProjectTemplates/content/BlazorWeb-CSharp/BlazorWebCSharp.1/Components/Account/Pages/Login.razor ## Impact WCAG 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value (invalid role) and 1.3.1 Info and Relationships (broken list semantics). Assistive technology may not convey the error list correctly. Affects every scaffolded Identity form, so it ships to every new Individual Accounts app. ## Evidence Verified with an automated accessibility scan of the scaffolded template and independently reproduced by a Blazor component test harness rendering the identical template markup. A screenshot showing the rendered `
                  ` carrying the two error list items is available on request.
